 Hoodies, sunglasses and smiles: BTS heads to Taiwan
 Listen Listen Text Size Print By Xportsnews Published Nov 18, 2026 5:03 pm KST
 BTS members head to the departure terminal at the Gimpo Business Aviation Center in western Seoul on Wednesday ahead of their flight to Kaohsiung, Taiwan, for their "ARIRANG" world tour. Xportsnews
 All seven members of BTS were spotted at the Gimpo Business Aviation Center in western Seoul on Wednesday afternoon as they departed for Kaohsiung, Taiwan, for their world tour.
 Members RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin, V and Jung Kook made their way to the departure terminal, some arriving separately, ahead of their flight.
 The Asian leg of the group's "ARIRANG" tour is kicking off in Kaohsiung on Nov. 19. BTS will hold a total of 15 performances across five cities, including Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and Singapore. 
 This article from Xportsnews was translated by a generative AI system and edited by The Korea Times.
